text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا

words.gloss_range: opening connector joining the decree unit to the prior narrative while allowing a fresh launch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: neighboring divine perfect verb that carries the transition into the decree unit

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens by keeping the previous Nuh-lineage scene close while also launching a new decree unit. Because it is fused directly into {{ar:قَضَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:qaḍaynā}}), the transition is carried by the divine act itself, not by a detachable preface. Its relation to the later {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the second charge gives the ayah two audible joints: source-frame first, then paired prediction.

topics.headline: linked launch after prior praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts as both continuation of the Nuh lineage scene and fresh disclosure of the Israelite decree.
topics.reason: The opening connector is attached to the perfect verb and the CRITICAL rows tie it to the preceding narrative boundary.

topics.headline: transition fused to divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition as part of the pronounced divine-act unit and as one joint in the ayah's two-wa architecture.
topics.reason: The surface spelling fuses the connector to {{ar:قَضَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:qaḍaynā}}), and the second connector later segments the second charge.

words.gloss_range: completed divine act of decreeing or conveying, locally narrowed by the recipient path and book frame
words.root_gloss_range: deciding, judging, completing, fulfilling, executing, and conveying; local syntax selects a settled communicated decree

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: recipient-path preposition that narrows the decree toward conveyed disclosure

words.prose: {{ar:قَضَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:qaḍaynā}}) is a completed divine perfect: the disclosure is grammatically finished before the two future acts are stated. The following {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) narrows the root from bare deciding to a conveyed decree sent toward Banī Isrāʾīl, while the legal-finalizing force of q-ḍ-y remains. Same-surah and wider echoes, especially 17:23 and 2:117, show the root moving between direct command, cosmic fiat, and communicated verdict. The first-person plural suffix also links preservation of Nuh descendants to this act of judgment-disclosure.

topics.headline: settled decree conveyed to recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a finished divine verdict being communicated toward the addressees, not a vague decision about them offstage.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural and the following {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) narrow q-ḍ-y to a settled decree conveyed to a recipient while retaining judgment force.

topics.headline: root moves between decree frames
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees q-ḍ-y as a recurring decree root that shifts from communicated warning here to direct command in 17:23 and cosmic command in 2:117.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallels at 17:23 and 2:117 and connect the decree root with the Book field.

topics.headline: same divine We changes action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears decisive opening weight and notices that the same divine speaker moves from preserving the lineage to disclosing its accountability.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows tie the heavy verb onset and first-person plural suffix to the movement from 17:3 into 17:4.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the named lineage as recipient endpoint of the decree
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) turns the decree into something directed to a recipient, with the whole Banī Isrāʾīl construct phrase under its scope. The preposition keeps a directional image, but the endpoint is a named community receiving disclosed knowledge rather than a place. Its position before the book-frame foregrounds the addressee first and the written authority second.

topics.headline: recipient endpoint for the decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Banī Isrāʾīl are grammatically the endpoint receiving the disclosed decree.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}) governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) as recipient complement of {{ar:قَضَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:qaḍaynā}}).

topics.headline: addressee foregrounded before medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first meets the named recipient line and only then the Book frame that authorizes the forecast.
topics.reason: The prepositional recipient phrase precedes {{ar:فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:fī al-kitābi}}), and the boundary row links generic descendants to a named lineage.

words.gloss_range: construct plural naming the children or people of Israel as a collective addressee
words.root_gloss_range: building, sonship, lineage, and constructed affiliation; local construct syntax selects collective lineage identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the addressee construct phrase
proper name completing the construct lineage phrase

words.prose: {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}) is both governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and governing the proper name that completes it, so the word is the hinge of the addressee phrase. As a construct plural, it makes the audience a definite collective lineage rather than generic children. The b-n-y field can carry building and affiliation pressure, but local syntax keeps the payoff on a constructed covenantal people whose identity recurs across Surah 17 at 17:2, 17:4, 17:101, and 17:104.

topics.headline: construct phrase fixes the addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that “children” is not generic: construct grammar binds the word into the definite Banī Isrāʾīl addressee.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and is the construct head completed by {{ar:إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:isrāʾīla}}).

topics.headline: lineage as built covenantal people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group as a collective lineage community, while building-root pressure remains supportive rather than replacing the kinship sense.
topics.reason: The b-n-y evidence allows lineage and building pressure, but local construct syntax selects the named people as addressee.

topics.headline: recurring Israelite discourse pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Banī Isrāʾīl as the discourse pivot joining the prior Nuh boundary to the Israelite arc of 17:2, 17:4, 17:101, and 17:104.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give same-surah recurrence, book-pairing in 17:2, and boundary movement from individual servant to collective addressee.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name completing the construct phrase and fixing the addressee identity
words.prose: {{ar:إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:isrāʾīla}}) completes the construct and fixes the addressee as a proper-name lineage, not an Arabic-root description. Variant recitational treatments alter the sound of the name without changing its referent. Any Hebrew-name resonance remains background; the local grammatical work is to make Banī Isrāʾīl a stable participant in the surah arc from 17:2 through 17:104.

topics.headline: proper name completes the lineage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is anchored by proper-name identity rather than by an Arabic root derivation.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a foreign proper noun, and attachment evidence makes it the genitive complement completing {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}).

topics.headline: name resonance held as background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register name-history and recitational texture without letting either change the local referent.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows note Hebrew-name semantics and qiraat sound variation, but the local parse uses the name as a stable foreign proper noun.

topics.headline: same-surah Israel frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this name as one node in the Surah 17 Israelite frame from guidance to corruption to later signs and land.
topics.reason: The rows cite the name at 17:2, 17:4, 17:101, and 17:104 as a same-surah arc.

words.gloss_range: preposition placing the decree in the Book while allowing the written frame to govern the following content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later land-domain phrase paired with the earlier Book-container phrase

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the decree within the Book and can also let that book-frame govern the following oath-like content. The preposition therefore works as containment and authority: the forecast is in a textual record and speaks under that record. Its recurrence before {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) creates a mirror between written containment and spatial enactment.

topics.headline: book frame contains and authorizes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the decree as located in a written authority whose scope can cover the following predictions.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) as a complement of {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), while CRITICAL rows preserve both local and broader content-scope readings.

topics.headline: text and land as paired containers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah organized by two containers: the prophecy in the Book and the corruption in the land.
topics.reason: The row set ties the first {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) to the second {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), and to the three-beat movement from decree to corruption to self-exaltation.

words.gloss_range: the identifiable Book, written record, or authoritative scripture containing the forecast
words.root_gloss_range: writing, joining, recording, prescribing, and textual authority; local phrase selects an authoritative written record
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is definite, so the decree is not floating in any writing but in an identifiable textual authority. The k-t-b field contributes inscription, joining, and prescription: the two future episodes are fixed as a bound record, not merely remembered. The singular base reading concentrates the witness in one Book, while the plural variant broadens textual attestation without changing the same forecast. Within Surah 17, the Book field shifts from guidance in 17:2 to warning-record here and later personal record language.

topics.headline: identifiable written authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forecast stands inside an identifiable Book that records, binds, and authorizes the decree.
topics.reason: The definite singular noun after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) narrows the k-t-b range toward authoritative written record while preserving inscription, joining, and prescription pressure.

topics.headline: singular base with plural witness variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the base reading concentrate the decree in one Book while variants widen the witness to books without changing the forecast.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows contrast singular {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) with plural {{ar:ٱلْكُتُبِ}} ({{tr:al-kutubi}}), so the variant affects textual scope, not local charge content.

topics.headline: Book shifts from guidance to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Israelite Book field change function: guidance in 17:2 becomes written warning in 17:4.
topics.reason: The evidence gives the Banī Isrāʾīl/Book recurrence and same-surah k-t-b functions.

topics.headline: preposition and Book heard as one frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Book phrase as a bound frame rather than as a peripheral afterthought.
topics.reason: The recitational liaison row ties {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) into one pronounced frame.

words.gloss_range: prefixed emphatic lām opening the first oath-like prediction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first emphatic corruption verb governed by the prefixed certainty marker

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) turns the first prediction into an oath-like, emphatic forecast. It is fused to {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}), so certainty is attached to the corrupting action before the heavy ending seals it. Because the same lām-plus-heavy-nūn pattern returns in the second charge, the reader hears a dyadic decree rather than a loose list.

topics.headline: first oath-like prediction marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first future corruption is grammatically certified, not merely predicted as a possibility.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support identify the lām with heavy nūn as emphatic or oath-like force in the first prediction.

topics.headline: certainty fused to first charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears certainty as attached to the corrupting verb and matched by the later second-charge downbeat.
topics.reason: The particle is prefixed to {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}) and begins the first forecast beat after the Book frame.

words.gloss_range: emphatic second-person plural Form IV forecast of causing corruption in the land
words.root_gloss_range: corruption, decay, disorder, and loss of soundness; local Form IV selects caused disorder rather than merely becoming corrupt
words.prose: {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}) addresses Banī Isrāʾīl directly as a plural “you” and encloses the forecast in emphatic morphology. Its Form IV causative is decisive: the base reading makes them agents who cause disorder in the land, while variant readings that internalize or passivize corruption expose how strong that active accountability is. The f-s-d field marks a loss of soundness and belongs to the Quranic corruption-in-earth formula, including the concern voiced in 2:30. Structurally, this first charge receives domain and exact count, unlike the second charge, which receives qualitative magnitude.

topics.headline: direct plural accountability under certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Banī Isrāʾīl being addressed directly in a sealed future form, with certainty built onto the verb.
topics.reason: The verb carries second-person plural agreement, emphatic lām plus heavy nūn, and no explicit repeated subject because the addressee is recovered from Banī Isrāʾīl.

topics.headline: base reading makes them corrupters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the base form assigns outward agency: they cause disorder in the land rather than merely decaying or being corrupted.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form IV, the frame has no direct object but a land-domain complement, and the qiraat rows show how passive or intransitive alternatives would change agency.

topics.headline: disorder in the human domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the charge as part of the Quranic corruption-in-earth discourse, including the concern voiced in 2:30.
topics.reason: The rows connect f-s-d with loss of soundness and with concrete corruption-in-earth parallels such as 2:30.

topics.headline: bounded first charge before qualitative second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first prediction as action plus domain plus exact count, distinct from the second prediction's qualitative intensification.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence binds the land phrase and {{ar:مَرَّتَيْنِ}} ({{tr:marratayni}}) to the first corruption clause.

topics.headline: gratitude flips to corruption warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the moral reversal from Nuh's gratitude to descendants warned of destructive disorder.
topics.reason: The boundary rows explicitly set the previous praise register beside this addressed corruption forecast.

words.gloss_range: second locative preposition binding the corruption clause to the land domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: land noun governed by the second locative preposition

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) belongs locally to the corruption clause and governs {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}). It prevents the charge from remaining abstract by making the land the arena that contains the disorder. Paired with the earlier {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) in the Book phrase, it makes the ayah move from written foreknowledge to territorial enactment.

topics.headline: corruption located in the land
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that corruption is not left abstract; it is enacted inside a land-domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) the governed complement of the second {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) under {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}).

topics.headline: Book and land mirror each other
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees written foreknowledge and earthly enactment held together by matching fī phrases.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly pair {{ar:فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:fī al-kitābi}}) with {{ar:فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:fī al-arḍi}}).

words.gloss_range: the definite land or earth as the domain in which corruption is enacted
words.root_gloss_range: land, earth, territory, and terrestrial stage; local definiteness keeps specific land and wider earth-scope in tension
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is definite, holding together “the land” and “the earth” as controlled scope rather than vagueness. It is the lower human stage on which the later language of rising high will be performed. The phrase enters a high-salience corruption-in-earth formula and also prepares tyranny-pattern echoes such as 28:4 and the anti-corruption pairing in 28:83. Surah 17 later returns to the land with Banī Isrāʾīl in 17:104, making the domain of corruption also a domain of settlement.

topics.headline: known land with wider earth pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a controlled scope: a known land can be in view while the corruption-in-earth formula keeps wider terrestrial pressure alive.
topics.reason: The singular definite form supports both specific territory and earth-wide domain without naming multiple lands.

topics.headline: earth stage prepares tyranny-height charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the land as the lower stage where corruption and later over-height meet, with tyranny echoes such as 28:4 and paired anti-corruption language in 28:83.
topics.reason: The rows connect land with corruption formulas and ʿ-l-w passages, including 28:4 and 28:83.

topics.headline: domain before count and later settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates the corruption before counting it and can later hear 17:104 as a return to the same domain.
topics.reason: The word order places the land phrase before {{ar:مَرَّتَيْنِ}} ({{tr:marratayni}}), and the same-surah row links the land to 17:104.

words.gloss_range: dual oblique count marking two complete occurrences of the corruption pattern
words.root_gloss_range: passing, occurrence, repetition, and bitterness as resonance; local form selects exact twofold occurrence
words.prose: {{ar:مَرَّتَيْنِ}} ({{tr:marratayni}}) mathematically fixes the first charge as two occurrences, not many or merely repeated corruption. Whether read as temporal adverbial or cognate-style specification, the dual form turns disorder into two complete event-passages. The m-r-r resonance of passage can carry bitterness as a secondary color, but it does not replace the exact count. The word also creates forward pressure because 17:7 begins resolving the count with first-time language.

topics.headline: two exact occurrences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mathematical precision: the forecast names two complete occurrences, not indefinite repetition.
topics.reason: QAC marks a dual oblique form, and attachment evidence licenses it as a count/specification of {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}).

topics.headline: counted passages with bitter color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the corruptions as complete passages through events, with bitterness only as secondary resonance.
topics.reason: The m-r-r field supports passage and bitterness, but the local dual noun selects “twice” as the governing sense.

topics.headline: dual count awaits first-time resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader expects the narrative to unpack the twofold count, and 17:7 begins that with first-time language.
topics.reason: The rows cite the movement from 17:4 “twice” to 17:7 “first time,” with 17:104 as a related same-surah land endpoint.

topics.headline: geminated sound matches doubled count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears doubled internal pressure in the word that names the twofold count.
topics.reason: The sound row ties the geminated consonant of {{ar:مَرَّتَيْنِ}} ({{tr:marratayni}}) to the dual meaning.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that opens the second emphatic charge beside the first

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused coordination-plus-certainty onset of the second charge

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the second prediction blocks the final phrase from being a mere restatement of corruption. It coordinates a second complete charge under the same emphatic architecture, pairing disorder with vertical overreach while keeping their meanings distinct. The fused {{ar:وَلَ}} ({{tr:wa-la}}) gives the second clause its own audible restart.

topics.headline: second prediction coordinated, not appositional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rising high is a second complete charge beside corruption, not a mere restatement of it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:تَعْلُنَّ}} ({{tr:taʿlunna}}) with {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}), and CRITICAL rows preserve the semantic distinction between disorder and overreach.

topics.headline: audible reset into second charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second charge restart with fused coordination and certainty.
topics.reason: The written/pronounced sequence {{ar:وَلَتَعْلُنَّ}} ({{tr:wa-la-taʿlunna}}) joins coordination to emphatic launch.

words.gloss_range: second emphatic lām giving the rising charge the same oath-like certainty as the corruption charge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second emphatic verb launched by the repeated certainty marker

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) repeats the same certainty marker used for the corruption forecast and launches the rising charge with equal force. It is bound directly into {{ar:تَعْلُنَّ}} ({{tr:taʿlunna}}), so the second prediction is not secondary or optional. The repeated lām makes certainty audible twice before the two roots diverge.

topics.headline: same certainty for rising charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that self-exaltation is forecast with the same grammatical certainty as corruption.
topics.reason: The second lām repeats the oath-like lām plus heavy nūn architecture already used with {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}).

topics.headline: certainty heard twice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated lām as a second downbeat attached directly to the rising verb.
topics.reason: The particle is bound into {{ar:وَلَتَعْلُنَّ}} ({{tr:wa-la-taʿlunna}}), and the sound row identifies repeated la as audible structural force.

words.gloss_range: emphatic Form I second-person plural forecast of self-exaltation or overreaching rise
words.root_gloss_range: height, rising, prevailing, loftiness, arrogance, and tyranny; local grammar selects absolute self-rising overreach, not causative raising

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first emphatic verb whose architecture is mirrored by the rising verb
following cognate noun and adjective that select excessive overreach

words.prose: {{ar:تَعْلُنَّ}} ({{tr:taʿlunna}}) states rising absolutely, without an explicit over-complement naming whom they rise over. The Form I surface keeps the rise in the addressees themselves rather than making them cause something else to be raised. The root image of height is selected by {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan kabīrā}}) as moral-political overreach, and the same emphatic architecture as {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}) makes the second charge equally certain. Echoes with 28:4 and 28:83 place this rising near tyranny and the paired corruption/exaltation field.

topics.headline: self-rising without named object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rise is absolute and located in the addressees themselves, not caused in another object and not explicitly over a named victim.
topics.reason: The local Form I verb has no {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) complement and no external object, while qiraat/form rows contrast causative elevation.

topics.headline: height becomes moral overreach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees physical height-language become moral and political overreach through the following cognate noun and adjective.
topics.reason: The broad ʿ-l-w range includes ascent and prevailing, but {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan kabīrā}}) selects excessive overreach here.

topics.headline: rising joins corruption as paired diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rising charge join corruption as a recognized moral pair, with tyranny and anti-corruption parallels at 28:4 and 28:83.
topics.reason: The rows connect the ʿ-l-w/f-s-d field to 28:83 and the highness-in-land pattern to 28:4, while local structure intensifies through the cognate object and adjective.

topics.headline: warning peaks into consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second verb sealed like the first and sees the ayah move from Nuh's servanthood contrast toward consequence in 17:5.
topics.reason: The sound row ties the heavy ending to {{ar:تُفْسِدُنَّ}} ({{tr:tufsidunna}}), and the boundary rows link the register shift to the next narrative movement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun of elevation functioning as cognate accusative for the rising verb
words.root_gloss_range: height, loftiness, transcendence, arrogance, and tyranny; local human subject and adjective select excessive overreach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final adjective qualifying the elevation noun

words.prose: {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan}}) repeats the same ʿ-l-w root as the verb and functions as its cognate accusative, so the clause grammatically performs excess by making rising take its own elevation as object. As the head qualified by {{ar:كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kabīrā}}), it receives the final magnitude. Its semantic range can include divine transcendence, but here the human subject and the surrounding corruption charge select arrogant overreach. The same phrase returns for divine transcendence in 17:43, while 28:83 pairs elevation and corruption as twin disqualifiers.

topics.headline: rising takes its own elevation as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices excess built into grammar: the verb is reinforced by its own verbal noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan}}) the cognate accusative of {{ar:تَعْلُنَّ}} ({{tr:taʿlunna}}).

topics.headline: magnitude attaches to elevation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final adjective modifying the elevation itself, so the charge lands on the magnitude of overreach.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kabīrā}}) the adjective of {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan}}).

topics.headline: height field morally revalued by subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same height field can be neutral or divine elsewhere, but with this human subject it becomes arrogant overreach.
topics.reason: The semantic rows preserve height and derivational variation, while the human addressee and final adjective narrow the local valence away from divine transcendence.

topics.headline: verbal noun keeps elevation enacted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the elevation as an enacted process magnified by indefiniteness, while variants shift texture toward adjectival highness.
topics.reason: The base form is a maṣdar-like verbal noun in accusative indefiniteness, and the qiraat variants preserve the elevation field while changing morphology.

topics.headline: human overreach against divine transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same elevation language condemn human arrogance here, pair with anti-corruption ethics in 28:83, and later describe rightful divine transcendence in 17:43.
topics.reason: The rows cite 28:83 and the exact same {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan kabīrā}}) phrase at 17:43.

topics.headline: paired accusative cadence closes the phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the noun and adjective bound as a single final landing phrase.
topics.reason: The cadence row ties shared accusative tanwīn in {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan}}) and {{ar:كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kabīrā}}) to the phrase closure.

words.gloss_range: indefinite adjective qualifying the elevation as great, serious, and large-scale
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, largeness, gravity, rank, and self-aggrandizement pressure; local syntax selects magnitude of overreach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: elevation noun qualified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kabīrā}}) agrees with {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan}}), so the final word qualifies the elevation itself rather than the whole clause loosely. It gives the overreach scale and gravity without a measured comparison, and the k-b-r field keeps self-aggrandizement nearby. Same-surah uses of magnitude, especially 17:43, make the closing phrase contrast illegitimate human elevation with rightful divine exaltation. Because the ayah ends on this adjective, magnitude is the last pressure before 17:5 begins the first promised consequence.

topics.headline: adjective fixes magnitude on elevation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word as the qualifier that makes the elevation large-scale, grave, and morally weighty.
topics.reason: Agreement links {{ar:كَبِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kabīrā}}) to {{ar:عُلُوًّۭا}} ({{tr:ʿuluwwan}}), and the k-b-r range selects magnitude and seriousness in this context.

topics.headline: greatness without measured comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the magnitude as qualitative and unbounded rather than a ranked comparison with another greatness.
topics.reason: The adjective is indefinite and qualitative, not the comparative/superlative {{ar:أَكْبَرُ}} ({{tr:akbar}}).

topics.headline: same phrase contrasts human and divine elevation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing magnitude participate in a same-surah contrast: human overreach in 17:4 versus divine transcendence in 17:43.
topics.reason: The rows cite k-b-r magnitude contexts, 8:73 for great corruption, Surah 17 magnitude uses, and the exact phrase recurrence at 17:43.

topics.headline: magnitude is the landing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears scale as the ayah's final pressure before 17:5 starts the first promised episode.
topics.reason: The final position, paired indefinite cadence, and bridge row connect the closing adjective to the next narrative consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The decree-to construction, the book, the corruption clause, and the dual occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive communication is fixed in a binding record, and its content is two countable departures from proper order. The dual therefore bounds the forecast as two realizations rather than an indefinite habit.

activation_trace.role: Decisive conveyance supplies a formally delivered sentence rather than an incidental observation.
Binding inscription supplies the normative record in which the forecast is fixed.
Departure from fitness supplies the failure state realized in each event.
Counted temporal occurrence makes the dual two delimited realizations.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts that corruption will happen twice.
changed_reading.after: A decisively communicated and binding record delimits two realizations of a breakdown from proper order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated emphatic clauses of corrupting in the earth and rising a great elevation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The elevation clause specifies a social form taken by the corruption clause: loss of order becomes self-magnifying domination, seizure, and competitive overcoming. The rise is therefore operative power over others, not only an inward attitude.

activation_trace.role: Loss of fitness supplies the damaged order that domination produces and exploits.
Blameworthy self-exaltation gives the rise its tyrannical social quality.
Overcoming and taking control turns vertical height into exercised domination.
Self-magnifying greatness intensifies the rise beyond ordinary advantage.
Competitive overcoming supplies the interpersonal force by which claimed greatness is enforced.

changed_reading.before: The second clause says that the addressees will become very arrogant.
changed_reading.after: The breakdown of order takes political form as self-magnifying domination and the active overcoming of others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lineage designation, the book, and the departure from order.
baseline_models.mechanism: The literal lineage branch is overlaid with construction and joining branches from the same focus. This makes the addressed group an intergenerational order assembled through descent and inscription; corruption is then the disarticulation of something socially built.

activation_trace.role: Descent and attribution supply the literal intergenerational body addressed by the verse.
Construction by joining parts models that lineage as an assembled social order.
Joining and fastening supplies inscription as a second means of holding the collective together.
Departure from sound order supplies the failure of the assembled lineage structure.

changed_reading.before: A named people receives a prediction about its future misconduct.
changed_reading.after: An intergenerational order held together by descent and inscription is warned that its own assembled structure will depart from fitness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding book is a guide given to the same lineage, while the prohibition against another keeper closes off transferred sovereignty. The carried-lineage cue then makes the focus corruption a failure of inherited custody: an order meant to guide remains inscribed but is violated in practice.

activation_trace.role: Lineage and attribution anchor the changed reading in the focus addressee.
Binding inscription anchors the warning as part of an obligatory order.
Departure from fitness becomes the breach committed against that entrusted order.
The written-book branch makes the immediately preceding guide the medium in which the focus warning is lodged.
Gentle direction toward a right way supplies the intended function that corruption defeats.
The keeper branch, under negation, frames the guidance as refusing outsourced guardianship.
Bearing an entrusted burden overlays the carried ancestry with inherited responsibility.

structural_cues: 17:2 repeats both the book and the same lineage immediately before the focus.
17:3 identifies the addressees as a carried descent and places grateful servanthood beside that inheritance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies book-as-guidance, barred delegated guardianship, and carried descent; I infer a custodial breach, while the live alternative is that the book only records a prediction and carries no custody mechanism here.

changed_reading.before: The book is chiefly the location of a prediction.
changed_reading.after: The warning is lodged inside an entrusted guide, so corruption also reads as inherited custody failing its directing purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first event is rendered as dispatched force moving repeatedly through the gaps of inhabited space. This gives corruption in the earth a spatial mechanism: the social ground has become penetrable through its interior seams, so external force can traverse dwellings rather than merely confront a boundary.

activation_trace.role: Departure from sound order supplies the internal condition that the incursion exposes.
The lower inhabited ground supplies the spatial substrate through which the failure spreads.
Dispatch and directed sending supplies the incoming agent of penetration.
Repeated movement through dwellings supplies the incursion's interior path.
Gaps between things supply the channels through which the damaged order is traversed.
Affiliation with a dwelling anchors the penetration in resident social space rather than abstract territory.

structural_cues: 17:5 moves from the focus's broad earth to the interior of dwellings during the first appointed event.
The sequence is directional: dispatch is followed by probing through interior space.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatched agents, traversal, gaps, and dwellings; I infer that external penetration manifests an internally unfit social-spatial order, while the alternative is that the incursion is only a later punishment and not a disclosure of corruption's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Corruption in the earth is broad territorial wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Corruption is also a loss of civil and domestic integrity that leaves inhabited space traversable from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first event is bounded by an appointment, followed by a restored turn and connected reinforcement, and then by reciprocal return. The non-dominant counting branch resolved from the appointment root sharpens the sequence: the two occurrences form a feedback loop in which restored capacity enables renewed elevation and renewed response.

activation_trace.role: Two counted temporal realizations anchor the loop in the focus dual.
An appointment bounded by time or place gives the first phase a set threshold.
The split mapping's recurrent time count turns appointment into a repeated temporal mechanism.
Return to a prior position supplies reversal after the first defeat.
Return and repetition after a first occurrence gives the restored turn its cyclical shape.
Connected reinforcement supplies the renewed capacity that can feed the next rise.
Return after departure, doubled across both sides, closes the sequence as a reciprocal loop.

structural_cues: The context labels a first appointment, restores a turn with resources, then names a later appointment.
17:8 explicitly pairs renewed conduct with renewed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, restoration, reinforcement, and reciprocal return; I infer that the second phase grows out of restored capacity, while the live alternative is two externally fixed episodes with no causal feedback between them.

changed_reading.before: Twice means two separate dates on which the same offense occurs.
changed_reading.after: Twice traces a resource-fed return loop: defeat, restored capacity, renewed elevation, and a corresponding renewed response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence enters the sanctuary, recalls the first occurrence, breaks apart what the addressees had risen over, and repeats the focus elevation root. The focus rise therefore acquires an occupiable institutional and territorial footprint that can be entered and dismantled, not merely an invisible feeling of pride.

activation_trace.role: Blameworthy self-exaltation anchors the later material footprint in the focus's censured rise.
Places of prostration establish the sacred spatial frame later re-entered by force.
Movement into an interior turns the consequence into an invasion of an occupiable structure.
The place of prostration locates the rise and its reversal in a sacred institution.
The recalled first occurrence explicitly ties the entry to the focus's counted pair.
Breaking, nullifying, and destroying supplies the reversal applied to the products of elevation.
The repeated root's domination branch makes what was risen over the scope of the dismantling.

structural_cues: 17:7 repeats the elevation root inside a sequence of entry and comprehensive breaking.
The phrase recalling the first occurrence binds that sequence to the focus dual.
The sanctuary in 17:7 echoes the paired sanctuaries that open the window.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sanctuary entry, recurrence, breaking, and a repeated elevation root; I infer that domination leaves an institutional or territorial structure behind, while the live alternative is that the later phrase denotes only whatever territory was overrun.

changed_reading.before: Great elevation is chiefly an attitude of extreme arrogance.
changed_reading.after: Great elevation becomes a dominative superstructure with a sacred and territorial footprint that a later reversal can enter and dismantle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The collective lineage address is decomposed by reflexive consequence, a record attached to each person, self-reckoning, and non-transferable burden. The twofold historical pattern can therefore remain collective without becoming indiscriminate collective guilt: it is assembled from acts that return to and remain with their agents.

activation_trace.role: The lineage branch anchors the large-scale collective addressed in the focus.
The self as the thing itself makes good and evil return to their own agents.
Binding and attaching a judgment supplies durable linkage between a person and the person's record.
Binding inscription turns personal action into an accountable record.
The self as one's own identity locates reckoning at the individual scale.
Counting and accounting supplies the operation by which the attached record is assessed.
A heavy carried burden supplies responsibility that cannot be shifted between persons.

structural_cues: 17:7 makes benefit and harm reflexive to the acting selves.
17:13-15 moves from each person's attached record to self-accounting and then denies transfer of burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective addressee plus self-returning deeds, attached records, and unshared burdens; I infer that the collective recurrence is emergent from individual accounts, while the alternative is that communal history and individual reckoning remain separate scales with no compositional claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus sounds like an undifferentiated collective sentence on a lineage.
changed_reading.after: The lineage bears a recurring historical pattern, but that pattern is composed of self-returning acts and individually attached, non-transferable accounts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counted time and fully separated detail lead into a book that is brought out, spread open, and read for reckoning. This revises the focus book from a passive container of prediction into an auditable recording architecture: the announced breakdown is both pre-inscribed as sentence and later legible through accumulated acts.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription anchors the focus warning in a record with normative force.
Enumeration supplies the temporal counting architecture that can distinguish the two occurrences.
Accounting converts counted time and action into assessable quantities.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies the record's granularity rather than a bare summary.
The written object supplies a concrete record produced for encounter and review.
An opened written record makes what was accumulated inspectable.
Reading and recitation supplies the act that turns inscription into disclosed evidence.
The repeated written-book branch links the disclosed personal record back to the focus book.

structural_cues: 17:12 joins counted years, accounting, and exhaustive detailing.
17:13-14 then presents a book, opens it to view, and commands its reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, detail, a written object, opening, and reading; I infer one auditable record architecture around the focus book, while the live alternative is that the focus names communal scripture and the later book is an unrelated personal ledger.

changed_reading.before: The book passively contains a forecast about two future events.
changed_reading.after: The book participates in an auditable system in which a binding sentence and the detailed acts that realize it become mutually legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rapid chain moves from obligation through affluent release, boundary exit, a sentence becoming binding, and comprehensive destruction. This supplies an executable mechanism for the focus: corruption is a breach at the empowered center that converts an inscribed judgment from warning into realized consequence.

activation_trace.role: A made-complete and effectuated act supplies the decree's transition from statement to execution.
Binding inscription supplies the standing sentence that can become due.
Departure from fitness anchors the later boundary breach in the focus corruption.
Demand and obligation supplies the normative boundary presented to the town's empowered actors.
Abundance that releases its possessor identifies excess capacity as the pressure point in the chain.
A fruit exiting its protective shell supplies the material image of crossing the normative boundary.
A fixed and due obligation supplies the point at which the sentence takes hold.
Extirpating destruction supplies the terminal execution of the sequence.

structural_cues: 17:16 uses a tightly linked verbal sequence from command to elite violation to sentence to destruction.
The actors singled out at the breach point are the town's affluent members, not an undifferentiated population.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, wealth-released actors, shell-exit, fixed liability, and destruction; I infer a causal execution chain, while the live alternative is that 17:16 states a general town pattern rather than unpacking the focus corruption.

changed_reading.before: Corruption is a broad moral label followed by an externally imposed punishment.
changed_reading.after: Corruption is an empowered boundary breach that makes the already inscribed sentence due and carries it into execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same connected extension that restores power earlier is later generalized as provision to both groups without restriction. The repeated comparative greatness and stepwise degrees then regrade the focus elevation: visible power is a contingent allocation inside a larger hierarchy, not evidence that self-exaltation is deserved or final.

activation_trace.role: Blameworthy self-exaltation anchors the contingent provision model in the focus rise.
Magnitude supplies the greatness later subjected to explicit comparison and grading.
Connected reinforcement supplies the material extension from which renewed worldly height grows.
The repeated extension branch generalizes reinforcement beyond the earlier restored party.
Giving and handing over supplies worldly capacity as received provision rather than self-originated status.
The prohibition branch, under negation, makes that provision unrestricted across the contrasted recipients.
Rank and excellence supply the explicit comparative scale against which elevation is reassessed.
Repeated comparative magnitude relocates ultimate greatness beyond the focus's worldly rise.
Step-by-step degrees supply a graded hierarchy that contains and relativizes visible height.

structural_cues: The reinforcement root appears both in the restored power of 17:6 and the provision extended to both groups in 17:20.
17:21 repeats a comparative form of greatness around explicit degrees and preference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common provision, repeated extension, comparative magnitude, and degrees; I infer that the focus rise is granted and reversible rather than self-validating, while the alternative is that censured elevation and later legitimate preference are only contrasts and share no allocation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The great rise appears as a self-produced peak of worldly superiority.
changed_reading.after: The rise is borrowed capacity within a larger grading system, so its magnitude is contingent, reversible, and no proof of deserved rank.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates rare material branches under the ordinary earth expression; it remains anchored in the focus's direct coupling of corruption, earth, and ascent, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy and never as the lexical translation of earth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Corruption in the earth followed by a conspicuous rise.

activation_trace.role: Departure from soundness supplies the general process of internal deterioration.
A wood-eating agent supplies the image of hidden consumption beneath an apparently standing structure.
A festering lesion supplies a second image of corruption spreading inside its substrate.
Visible ascent supplies the upper structure whose supporting ground is being hollowed out.

changed_reading.before: Territorial corruption and great ascent are two adjacent political claims.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the rise expands visibly while hidden consumption and festering hollow out the ground that supports it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-primary construction, joining, cord, and upper-load branches for forms whose immediate senses are lineage, book, twice, and rising; the shared focus roots keep the topology anchored, but downstream prose should label it a structural analogy rather than replace any surface sense with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The built lineage, joined book, two occurrences, and great elevation within one focus sentence.

activation_trace.role: Construction by joining parts supplies a built collective capable of bearing a repeated pattern.
Joining and fastening consolidates the two events into one inscribed structure.
A tightly twisted cord models the two occurrences as mutually reinforcing strands rather than isolated points.
A load carried above supplies the elevated structure borne by the paired strands.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two corruptions and then a great rise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained structural analogy, the two corruptions are tightly twisted strands that jointly bear and intensify one elevated order.

strongest_changes: The dual becomes a resource-fed return loop rather than two isolated dates.
The great elevation acquires an institutional and territorial footprint that later entry and breaking can dismantle.
The book becomes both entrusted guidance and an auditable record that connects sentence, action, and reckoning.
The collective historical pattern is decomposed into self-returning acts and non-transferable individual accounts.
Later common provision and comparative degrees regrade worldly elevation as contingent rather than self-validating.
summary.what_was_special: The most diagnostic activation came from the appointment root's split mapping into recurrent counting, reinforced by the return vocabulary, the direct reappearance of the elevation root inside the destruction sequence, and the later chain of counting, detailing, opening, and reading a book.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus book may remain specifically communal scripture rather than sharing one record architecture with the later personal book.
The later object of breaking may be the full institutional footprint of domination or only whatever territory was overrun.
The two events may be a causal feedback loop or two appointed episodes whose internal relation is only sequential.
The substrate and twisted-cord outliers are analogical activations, not proposed lexical senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Corruption is imbalance amplified into vertical domination.** `ف س د:B001` is departure from sound balance, while doubled `ع ل و:B003/B004` supplies haughty domination and mastery; `م ر ر:B002` marks repeated occurrence. Their sequence moves from damaged ground-order to emphatic ascent, and 17:37–38 later rejects the fantasy of piercing earth and reaching mountains. I infer فساد → compensatory self-elevation → domination. The forecast reads as a repeatable social mechanism, not two disconnected offenses.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:43 corrected `ع ل و`: divine elevation is purified from the domination forecast here, making this “great height” a counterfeit verticality rather than greatness itself.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Corruption as a vertical regime that invites inversion.** Lexical evidence: `ع ل و B003` (haughty domination) in the doubled `لَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا`, alongside `ف س د B001` (departure from soundness and balance). Structural cue: 17:5 sends agents through domestic interiors, 17:6 reverses advantage, and 17:7 destroys `مَا عَلَوْا`; the root of rising thus recurs at the endpoint of the cycle. Assigned role: `ع ل و` supplies the dominating vertical order and `ف س د` its systemic imbalance. Abductive move: the ayat supply ascent and later dismantling; I infer that domination causes the imbalance that makes reversal fitting. Reading change: the announced corruption is not diffuse misconduct but an elevated power arrangement whose very height becomes the object of undoing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:7 supplied the strongest later correction: `مَا عَلَوْا۟` makes the earlier doubled rising the explicit object of dismantling, fixing corruption as a vertical regime rather than generic disorder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı karara bağlama anlamıyla kesin bir buyruk verme anlamını aynı dalda açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kesinlik, yalnızca kararın söylenmesini değil, konunun ayrılıp sonuçlandırılmasını da anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bildirimde bulunmayı, bir işi bitirmeyi, borç ödemeyi veya ölümü değil; bağlayıcı bir yargı ya da kesin buyruk vermeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, hükme bağlama ve kesin buyruk verme çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır; başka dallara özgü kalıp anlamları bu tanıma katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir uyuşmazlığı hükme bağlayıp taraflar için kesin bir karara varmak veya bir işi bağlayıcı bir buyrukla kesinleştirmektir.

facets.statement: Uyuşmazlığı değerlendirip taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir karara varma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çekirdeği karar verme ve işi kesin biçimde sonuca bağlama olarak ortaklaşa sunar; yargısal kullanımda bu, taraflar arasındaki ayrımı bağlayıcı bir hükümle belirler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yargısal karar ile bağlayıcı buyruğun ortak çekirdeğini, konuyu kesin biçimde sonuca bağlama yönüyle birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Karar verme, bağlayıcılık ve kesin sonuca bağlama özelliklerini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli yönelme kalıplarında bir ahdi, vasiyeti veya talimatı iletmeyi ve bir bilgiyi kesin biçimde muhataba ulaştırmayı açıkça bir araya getirir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru biçimde yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir gereksinimi, ibadeti, süreyi veya başka bir işi tamamlayıp bitirme ile bir şeyin geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve yok olması aşamalarını açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçeve, tamamlanan eylem ile sona eren şey arasındaki katılımcı farkını koruduğu sürece uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem bir işi bitirmeyi hem de bir şeyin sona erip tükenmesini kapsar; ölüm ve borç ödeme ancak kendi ayrı dallarında ele alınır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, sona erme bildiren biçim ile belirli iş, gereksinim, ibadet ve süre söz öbeklerini ayırır; bu kalıpların bütün ayrıntıları çıplak biçime yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, gereksinimi, ibadeti veya süreyi son sınırına ulaştırıp tamamlamak; ya da bir şeyin süresi dolarak geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve ortadan kalkmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi veya süreci gereken son sınıra ulaştırarak tamamlayıp bitirme.
Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı sona ererek geçip gitmesi ve tükenmesi.
Bir işin artık geri alınamayacak biçimde kesin olarak sonuçlanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir işi bitirip ondan çıkma ile bir şeyin süresinin veya varlığının tükenip gitmesini aynı sona ulaşma çevresinde birleştirir; bazı kullanımlarda sonuç geri alınamaz duruma gelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi yapmak, biçimlendirmek ve kusursuzca tamamlamak ile tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla yürürlüğe koymayı ortak bir sonuçlandırma çekirdeğinde destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki yaratma ve yapma örnekleri, genel bir var etme anlamına genişletilmeden bu sınır içinde kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca yapma, kusursuzca tamamlama ve eylemi yürürlüğe koyma çekirdeğidir; salt planlama, ölçme veya sözlü karar verme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yapıp kusursuzca tamamlama çekirdeğini belirli yaratma, iş görme ve sağlam ürün söz öbeklerinden ayırır; bu örneklerin özel kapsamı çıplak biçime taşınmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi yapıp kusursuzca tamamlamayı ve istenen eylemi sonuca kadar yürütmeyi ortaklaştırır; yaratma örneği de ortaya çıkarma ile işi bitirme aşamalarını birlikte taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, kuru üzüm çekirdeğini adlandıran bir ad biçimi ile bu çekirdeği yeme eylemini aynı tanıklıkta açıkça verir. Geçici çerçeve, yiyecek nesnesi ile onu yeme eylemi arasındaki ayrımı koruyarak kaynağı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kuru üzüm çekirdeğinin adı ve onu yeme kalıbıdır; genel yemek yeme veya başka meyve parçalarını adlandırma anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, kuru üzüm çekirdeğini adlandıran biçim ile bu çekirdeği yeme söz öbeğini ayrı tutar; özel yiyecek nesnesi genel yeme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Kuru üzüm çekirdeğini adlandırmak ve belirli söz öbeğinde kişinin bu çekirdeği yemesini anlatmaktır.

facets.statement: Kuru üzümün içindeki çekirdeği belirli bir adla belirtme.
Belirli söz öbeğinde kişinin kuru üzüm çekirdeğini yemesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için kaynaklar arası ortak bir özet kurulamaz; yiyecek nesnesi ve onu yeme eylemi tek bir sözlük kaydında birlikte tanıklanır.

source_details.summary: Kuru üzüm çekirdeğinin adı ve kişinin bu çekirdeği yemesi dalın tek tanıklığında birlikte verilir.

concept_gloss.text: kuru üzüm çekirdeği ve onu yemek
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yiyecek nesnesini ve yalnızca belirli söz öbeğinde tanıklanan yeme eylemini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kuru üzüm çekirdeği nesnesini ve bu çekirdeği yeme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözcük bir yiyecek nesnesinin, yani kuru üzümün çekirdeğinin adı olarak kullanıldığında geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Adlandırılan yiyecek nesnesini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu çekirdeği yeme eylemini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bu belirli yiyecek parçasını yediğini bildiren söz öbeğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yiyecek nesnesini ve onu yeme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Çekirdeğin bağımsız ad olarak kullanılmasını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuru üzüm çekirdeğini yeme eylemini belirli bir söz öbeğinde adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Nesne adında iki dal örtüşür; odak dal ayrıca bu çekirdeği yeme kalıbını içerirken komşu dal çekirdekten türeyen başka adlara uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yenilen şeyi kuru üzüm çekirdeğiyle sınırlar ve aynı zamanda bu nesnenin adını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü yiyeceği yeme, yedirme, lokma ve yeme sıklığı gibi genel kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin bir yiyeceği ağzına alıp yemesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel yeme alanıdır; odak dal yalnızca kuru üzüm çekirdeği nesnesi ve onu yeme söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, parçaları birbirine katarak bir bütün kurma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Bununla birlikte aynı kanıt, kurma eyleminin sonucunu ve bir başkasına ev kurma olanağı sağlamayı da içerdiğinden dal yalnızca yalın bir eylem olarak tanımlanamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kurma eylemi çekirdektir; kurulmuş şey sonuç, başkasına ev ya da gereç verme ise belirli bir ettirgen kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın kurma çekirdeği ile sonuç adını ve belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı ettirgen kullanımları birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Parçaları birbirine ekleyerek düzenli bir yapı kurmak ve bu eylemin ortaya çıkardığı bütündür. Belirli bir kullanımda, bir başkasına ev kurması için ev ya da gerekli gereci vermeyi de anlatır.

facets.statement: Parçaları birbirine ekleyerek düzenli ve ayakta duran bir bütün kurma eylemi.
Kurma eyleminin sonucu olan ev, duvar, saray veya gök gibi kurulmuş bütün.
Birine ev kurabilmesi için ev ya da gerekli gereci vererek kurma olanağı sağlama.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, parçaların bir araya getirilmesiyle bir yapı kurmayı, kurulan şeyi ve bir başkasına ev kurma olanağı sağlamayı aynı dalda toplar.

concept_gloss.text: parçaları birleştirerek yapı kurma, kurulan yapı ve kurmaya olanak sağlama
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın eylem, sonuç ve belirli ettirgen kullanımını birlikte göstermek gereken kapsamlı açıklamalarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kurma işlemini, ortaya çıkan yapıyı ve başkasına kurma olanağı sağlamayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Parçaların bir araya getirilerek ev, duvar veya başka bir bütün oluşturulduğu eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Parçaları birleştirerek bir bütün oluşturma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kurulmuş sonuç adını ve başkasına kurma olanağı sağlama kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kurma eyleminden doğan ev, duvar veya benzeri somut sonuçtan söz edilen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kurma eyleminin ortaya çıkardığı düzenli bütünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kurma eylemini ve başkasına kurma olanağı sağlama kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bütün yapıyı kurma eylemini ve kurulan sonucu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yapının yalnızca temeline, ilk dayanağına ve temel atma aşamasına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yapının oluşturulma sürecinde ve ayakta durmasında rol oynar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal parçaları birleştirerek bütün yapıyı kurmayı anlatır; komşu dal ise bu sürecin yalnızca temel ve başlangıç dayanağı bölümünü adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür parçayı birleştirerek yapı kurmayı ve kurulan bütünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yapıyı yükseltme, sağlamlaştırma ve sıvayla kaplama gibi özel işlemleri içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yapının ortaya çıkarılması ve sağlam duracak biçime getirilmesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel kurma işlemi ve sonucudur; komşu dal yükseltme, sağlamlaştırma ve sıvama gibi daha özel bir yapı işini belirtir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular incelendi; temel atma ve özel yükseltme dalları sınırı en açık biçimde gösterdiği için yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: بناء الشيء بضم بعضه إلى بعض
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفعل بنى، والبناء والبنيان لما يبنى، وبناء البيت والدار والقصر والحائط والسماء، وإعطاء ما يبنى به البيت.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هذا فرع الابن والبنت، ولا قوس بانية، ولا المبناة الخاصة من الأدم أو النطع، ولا مجاز صحة البنية وحده.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin üzerine kurulduğu düzeni ve kişinin doğuştan gelen beden kuruluşunu doğrudan belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki yakın görünümü tek bir kuruluş biçimi çekirdeğinde doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kurma eylemini değil, bir şeyin kurulmuş düzenini veya doğuştan gelen yapısını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin kuruluş ve doğuştan yapı anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki özel söz öbekleri buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerine kurulduğu düzen, biçim veya bileşimdir; kişi için doğuştan gelen beden kuruluşunu da anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kurulmuş olduğu düzen, biçim ve bileşim.
Bir kişinin doğuştan gelen ve sağlamlık bakımından değerlendirilebilen beden kuruluşu.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bir şeyin kuruluş biçimini bildirir ve insan bağlamında bunu doğuştan gelen beden yapısı olarak özelleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem genel nesne düzenini hem de kişinin doğuştan beden kuruluşunu kapsayan açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kurulmuş düzeni ve insan için doğuştan beden yapısı özelleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin doğuştan gelen fiziksel kuruluşu veya sağlamlığı söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin doğuştan gelen fiziksel kuruluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan dışındaki şeylerin genel kuruluş biçimini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin parçalarının nasıl düzenlendiği ve hangi biçim üzerine kurulduğu anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin kurulmuş düzenini ve biçimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Doğuştan beden yapısına özgü değerlendirmeyi açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan dışındaki şeylerin genel kuruluş biçimini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bedenin karışımını ve doğal eğilimlerini oluşturan özel bileşime odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bedenin nasıl kurulduğunu ve parçalarının nasıl bir bütün oluşturduğunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel kuruluş biçiminden bedene uzanır; komşu dal doğrudan bedenin bileşimine ve doğal karışımına bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir nesnenin kurulmuş düzenini ve bedenin biçimsel yapısını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlının yaratılıştan gelen huyunu ve değişmez doğal eğilimini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir canlıda doğuştan bulunan ve sonradan edinilmemiş özellikleri anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal biçimsel kuruluş ve bileşime yönelir; komşu dal yaratılıştan gelen özellik ve doğal eğilim alanına daha geniş biçimde uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Parçaların iç düzenini ve bir bütünün hangi yapı üzerine kurulduğunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dışarıdan görülen boy, duruş ve genel görünüşü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin veya şeyin fiziksel biçimini betimlemekte kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iç kuruluş ve bileşimi öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise dıştan görülen boyu, duruşu ve görünüşü belirtir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar incelendi; beden bileşimi, doğuştan özellik ve dış görünüşle olan üç yakın sınır yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, aynı yalın biçimin merkezi kutsal yapı ve onun bulunduğu kutsal şehir için özel bir ad olarak kullanıldığını açıkça bildirir. Geçici çerçeve bu adlandırma alanını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel bir yapı ya da şehir türünü değil, belirli kutsal yapı ve şehir için kullanılan özel adı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca yalın biçimin özel ad değerini verir; genel yapı kurma veya kuruluş biçimi anlamı buraya alınmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kare biçimli ve yüksek her yapıya uzanabilen bir yapı türü adını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da aynı merkezi kutsal yapıyı gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal o yapının ve şehrin özel adıdır; komşu dal ise kutsal örneğin yanında kare biçimli başka yapıları da kapsayan bir yapı adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kutsal yapı ile kutsal şehri aynı ad altında gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kutsal şehrin içindeki belirli bölgeyi, alanı veya dolaşma yerini gösterebilen ayrı bir yer adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aynı kutsal şehir ve onun merkezindeki kutsal alanla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak yer alanına rağmen adlar ve gösterdikleri sınırlar farklıdır; odak dal yapı ile şehre, komşu dal ise şehir içindeki belirli yere yönelebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir ev türünden daha geniştir: çadırımsı örtü, perde, deri yaygı, hasır ve saklama kabı gibi ayrı nesneleri aynı ad çevresinde sıralar. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bu nesne dizisini yalnızca ev ya da örtü diye daraltmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek genel yapı kurma değildir; belirli biçimlerin örtü, yaygı veya kap olarak adlandırılmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel ad biçimlerini kapsar ve bunları yalın kurma anlamına genellemez; kökeni tartışmalı oturuş anlatımı yalnızca ayrı sözlük biriminde kalır.

concept_map.definition: Deri veya benzeri malzemeden yapılan çadırımsı örtü, perde, yaygı, hasır ya da saklama kabı için kullanılan nesne adıdır. Bir başka kullanımda yağmurdan korunmak veya yere sermek üzere açılan yaygıyı belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir evi örten veya çadırımsı biçim oluşturan deri örtü ya da perde.
Deri ya da benzeri malzemeden yaygı, hasır veya saklama kabı olarak kullanılan nesne.
Yağmurdan korunmak, namaz kılmak veya malı sergilemek için yere serilen yaygı.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çadırımsı deri örtüden yaygı, hasır ve saklama kabına uzanan bir nesne dizisi verir; ayrıca yere serilen yaygı kullanımını bildirir.

concept_gloss.text: deriden örtü, çadırımsı kap, yaygı veya saklama kabı

branches.branch_image_ar: المَبْناة بيت أو غطاء من أدم
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المبناة كهيئة القبة أو الستر من أدم، والنطع أو الحصير أو العيبة، والبناء المبسوط في المطر أو على المتاع.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yayın kirişine olağandışı ölçüde yapışmasını ve kirişin kopma noktasına yaklaşmasını kusur olarak açıkça tanımlar. Bölgesel biçim aynı kusurlu yay adının değişkesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel olarak yayı veya yapışmayı değil, kirişine aşırı yaklaşmış kusurlu yay durumunu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yay ve kirişten oluşan özel söz öbeğine ve onun bölgesel biçimine bağlı tutulur; yalın bir yapışma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kirişine aşırı ölçüde yaklaşarak yapışmış ve bu yüzden kirişi kopma tehlikesine sokmuş kusurlu yaydır.

facets.statement: Yayın gövdesinin kendi kirişine olağandışı ölçüde yaklaşması ve yapışması.
Bu temasın kirişi neredeyse koparacak kadar güçlü olması ve bir yay kusuru sayılması.
Aynı kusurlu yay için belirli bir toplulukta kullanılan farklı biçim.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yayın kirişine yapışmasını ve kirişin kopma tehlikesini aynı kusurun öğeleri olarak verir; ayrıca bölgesel bir biçim bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yayın gövdesi ile kiriş arasındaki tehlikeli yakınlık ve kusur birlikte anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yayın kirişine yapışmasını, kopma tehlikesini ve kusur niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: kirişine yapışıp onu kopma sınırına getiren yay

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geçerli söz öbeğini gelini götürme ve eşle birleşme anlamlarıyla açıklar, bunu yapan erkek için de bir ad verir. Aynı kanıt, başka bir ilgeçle kurulan yaygın biçimi kaynak dilin yerleşik kullanımı dışında sayarak sınırı açıkça çizer.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal evlilik kurumunun tamamı değil, gelinin götürülmesi ve eşlerin düğün gecesi birleşmesi çevresindeki özel kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtlanan söz öbeği ve ona bağlı kişi adıyla sınırlıdır; reddedilen ilgeçli biçim veya genel yapı anlamı buraya alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gelini yeni evine götürmek veya erkeğin düğün gecesi eşiyle birleşmesidir; bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek için de kullanılan bir adı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gelinin yeni evine götürülmesi ve erkeğin düğün gecesi eşiyle birleşmesi.
Düğün gecesinde eşler için bir çadır kurulmasıyla açıklanan geleneksel bağlantı.
Bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek için kullanılan damat adı.
Başka bir ilgeçle kurulan yaygın biçimin yerleşik kaynak dil kullanımı dışında sayılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelini götürme ile eşle birleşme anlamlarını, bunlarla ilgili damat adını ve alternatif ilgeçli biçime yönelik açık kullanım sınırını birlikte verir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بنى بأهله الذي حكمت بعض المصادر بأنه من كلام العامة أو خطأ، ولا البناء المعماري المجرد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gerçek oğul-kız bağını, birini oğul edinmeyi ve bir kaynaktan çıkma, yetiştirilme, hizmet veya sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle aktarılan adlandırmaları birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak gerçek soy ile aktarılmış bağlılık aynı ilişkiymiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Gerçek çocukluk bağı çekirdektir; edinme ve kaynağa ya da sürekli bağlılığa dayalı adlandırmalar ayrı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çocuk ve çocukluk bağı biçimleriyle, edinme eylemini ve belirli bağlılık söz öbeklerini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak soy bağıyla bağlı olması ve bu bağın adıdır. Birini oğul edinmeye, oğulluğunu ileri sürmeye ve bir kaynaktan çıkma, onun tarafından yetiştirilme ya da ona sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla anılmaya da uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak anne babasıyla taşıdığı gerçek çocukluk ve soy bağı.
Bir kişiyi oğul edinme veya onun oğulluğunu ileri sürme.
Bir şeyden çıkma veya onun tarafından yetiştirilme nedeniyle çocuk adıyla kurulan aktarılmış bağ.
Bir uğraşa, yola, zamana veya bilgi alanına sürekli hizmet ve bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla anılma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gerçek oğul-kız bağını ve çocukluk adlarını verir; toplu kanıt bunları çocuk edinmeye, köken ilişkisine ve sürekli bağlılığa dayalı adlandırmalara genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gerçek soy bağı ile edinilmiş veya aktarılmış çocuk adlandırmalarının tümünü birlikte göstermek gereken açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.branch_image_ar: البُنُوَّة والنسب وما ينسب إلى منشأ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الابن والبنت والبنون والأبناء والبنات والبنوة، والتبني، وما يسمى ابنا أو بنتا لأنه يحصل من جهة شيء أو تربيته أو خدمته أو ملازمته.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هذا بناء البيت، ولا البنية للهيئة، ولا ألفاظ بنات الطريق والحصى إلا من جهة المجاز الاسمي.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الابن أصله بنو (sihah;mufradat)؛ البنوة مصدر الابن (tahdhib)؛ تبنيت فلانا إذا اتخذته ابنا (sihah)؛ تبنيته إذا ادعيت بنوته (tahdhib)؛ سماه بذلك لكونه بناء للأب (mufradat)؛ كل ما يحصل من جهة شيء أو من تربيته أو بتفقده أو كثرة خدمته له أو قيامه بأمره هو ابنه (mufradat)؛ فلان ابن الحرب وابن السبيل وابن الليل وابن العلم (mufradat)؛ بنت فلان وابنة فلان وبنات (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi küçük yan yolları, küçük oyuncak biçimlerini, çakıl taşını ve yerden çıkan bir otu çocuk adlarıyla anar. Ayrıca bir şeyden çıkanın onun çocuğu sayılabileceği genel bağlantıyı verdiği için geçici çerçeve örnekleri doğru bir ortak uzantıda toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek insan soyunu değil, küçüklük, dallanma veya bir kaynaktan çıkma nedeniyle çocuk adı verilen nesneleri kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtlanan çoğul biçim ve söz öbeklerindeki nesne adlarını kapsar; bunları yalın çocukluk anlamıyla birleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Küçük, ana bütünden dallanmış veya yerden çıkmış bazı şeylerin oğul ya da kız adıyla anılmasıdır; küçük yan yollar, oyuncak insan biçimleri, tapınma yerindeki çakıllar, bir yer taşı ve bir ot türü bu adlandırmanın örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyden çıkma, küçüklük veya ana bütünden dallanma nedeniyle nesneye çocuk adı verme.
Ana yoldan ayrılan küçük yolların kız çocukları bildiren bir çoğulla adlandırılması.

Bir çakıl taşının yerin kızı, bir ot türünün de yerin oğlu olarak adlandırılması.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi göğüs kafesi kaburgalarını, ev direklerini ve bir yere yerleşip huzur bulma sözünü birlikte verir. Destek ve yerleşiklik bağlantısı dalı tutarlı kılar, ancak somut parçalar ile yerleşme eylemi tek bir nesne tanımı gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kaburga ve ev direği somut destek adlarıdır; yerleşip huzur bulma ise yalnızca belirli söz öbeğine bağlı eylem uzantısıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel çoğul biçimlerdeki kaburga ve direk adlarını, yerleşme söz öbeğinden ayrı tutar ve bunları yalın bir destek anlamına genellemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlam çekirdeğini bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp birleştirmek olarak açıkça kurar; deri dikme, hayvanın bazı uzuvlarını bağlama, boncukla tutturma ve birlik oluşturma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğin özelleşmiş gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı yazma ya da hüküm verme anlamını değil, fiziksel veya toplu birleştirme işlemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, katma ve birleştirme çekirdeğinin dikiş, bağlama, sıkıca kapatma ve düzenli topluluk oluşturma gibi somut uygulamalarda korunmasıdır.
